Home/Free water test

Free water testing at your home

Dan comes to your home, tests your water and tells you what he finds. There’s no charge and no obligation to buy anything. Sometimes the answer is that your water, or the system you already have, is fine.

Book a free water test Call 734-878-2572

What we test for

  • Hardness, the cause of scale and spots
  • Iron, behind rust stains and metallic taste
  • Hydrogen sulfide, the rotten-egg smell
  • pH and chlorine
  • Nitrates, sediment and bacteria, with lab testing when needed

How it works

  1. Request a test with the form below, or call or text 734-878-2572.
  2. Dan sets a time that works for you.
  3. He tests at your tap and walks you through the results.
  4. You get a straight answer on what, if anything, your water needs.

When to test

Test once a year if you’re on a well, and any time you notice a change in taste, smell or staining. City water is treated, but it can still be hard or carry chlorine you’d rather not taste.

Common questions

How often should I test my water?

Once a year, especially if you’re on a well, and any time you notice a change in taste, smell, or staining.

Is the water test really free?

Yes. Dan tests at your home and explains the results on the spot. There’s no obligation to buy anything.

Can I test my water myself?

Home test kits are available, but a professional test is more accurate and comes with someone who can tell you what the numbers mean.
